payload.subject: Why more discovery calls isn't a volume problem
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most businesses think booking more discovery calls means sending more messages.


It usually doesn't.


It means replying faster and following up more consistently than the next option.


Here's the pattern:


A lead raises their hand. Nobody answers for a few hours. Follow-up stops after one attempt.


That's not a lead problem. That's a process problem.


Here's the fix, in three steps:


1. Reply to every new lead in under 5 minutes, automatically.


2. Ask one qualifying question so you only talk to people who fit.


3. Book the call straight onto your calendar from the same thread.


That's The AI Growth Engine: AI handles the first touch and the follow-up, you handle the conversation.


This works best for businesses that book 1:1 appointments — if that's not you, skip this one.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — https://link.digigrowthllc.com/widget/booking/tydZBa2ehjdSRZopOMrn


Talk soon,


Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if it's a fit.
